questions.q: Why does she have a cheat meal?
o: She and her husband are on a diet and a sugar crisis hit
questions.e: In the video: "Muž i ja smo već dve nedelje na dijeti i udarila je šećerna kriza" — my husband and I have been on a diet for two weeks and a sugar crisis hit.

questions.q: What will she compare in the series?
o: Whether it's faster, cheaper and tastier to make at home
questions.e: In the video: "gledaćemo da li je brže napraviti je kod kuće ili poručiti" — we'll look at whether it's faster to make it at home or to order.

questions.q: Why does she rarely make pancakes at home?
o: You have to make a huge number of them
questions.e: In the video: "Palačinke jako retko pravim kod kuće, zato što moraš da napraviš milion." — I very rarely make pancakes at home, because you have to make a million.

questions.q: Which pancake did she choose to compare?
o: Euro krem, Plazma in milk, banana
questions.e: In the video: "Napravit ćemo moju omiljenu: euro krem, plazma u mleku, banana palačinku" — we'll make my favourite: euro krem, Plazma in milk, banana pancake.

questions.q: What went wrong with the first pan?
o: Pancakes started to stick on it
questions.e: In the video: "na ovom tiganju ne mogu da se prave palačinke, zato što je počeo da se lepi" — you can't make pancakes on this pan, because it started to stick.

questions.q: What did she add to the second batter?
questions.e: In the video: "Stavit ću ovaj put jaje" — this time I'll put in an egg.

questions.q: How much did the pancakes weigh?
questions.e: In the video: "Njihova ima 560 grama, svaka čast, a naša 706." — theirs is 560 grams, hats off, and ours is 706.

questions.q: Which pancake did she like more?
questions.e: In the video: "I iskreno, radije bih jela ovu domaću." — and honestly, I'd rather eat this homemade one.
